newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai mayor says Clinton eyes China trip.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai mayor says Clinton eyes China trip.

text.p: Shanghai Mayor Xu Kuangdi has returned from a visit to the United States with a message from President Clinton saying he hopes to visit China during 1997, an official with Shanghai Television said on Thursday.

The official said that during an interview with Shanghai TV, Xu said Vice President Al Gore asked him to relay a message to China's government from Clinton, saying the U.S. leader hoped to visit next year, the official said. He did not elaborate.
Clinton, who has not visited Beijing since taking office in 1993, is scheduled to meet Chinese President Jiang Zemin this weekend in Manila at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum summit.
